verdict.rationale: No evidence in the pack addresses AI-training opt-out or data-use controls for Expensify; the only AI-related mentions describe Expensify's own AI features, not user control over data being used to train models. There is also concrete evidence Expensify has historically sent user receipt data to third-party human contractors (MTurk) without confidentiality safeguards, which undercuts any implicit privacy assurance, but no explicit AI-training opt-out mechanism is documented either way.
